TextBlock.Text: Soviet officials claim peace talks in progress with Japanese officials in Tokyo.
Washington declares there will be no peace until Japan is returned to democracy.

StackPanel.TextBlock:
Despite heavy press censorship, several anonymous sources claim most of US 7th Fleet's carriers are heavily damaged or sunk.
Soviet newspapers claim multiple American carrier groups destroyed in the Pacific and Indian Oceans.
Military families across America press for answers as soldiers, sailors and aviators miss calls and mail.

Soviet and European officials wrap up energy talks as Moscow promises Siberian oil and gas in exchange for increased economic ties with Western Europe.
Energy markets throughout Western Europe stabilize after 3 weeks of uncertainty.
Moscow assures new Baltic pipelines will be laid, connecting Europe to Soviet oil and gas.

TextBlock.Text: SOVIET OFFICIALS CLAIM FREE AND FAIR ELECTIONS IN JAPAN SOON

StackPanel.TextBlock:
In a speech today, the Soviet Foreign Minister claimed that democratic elections will soon return to Japan once formerly banned Socialist parties are added to the polls.
American pro-democracy think tanks question fairness of any election done under the watchful eyes of the KGB. Concern grows as many Japanese government officials disappear, or resign positions to Soviet-appointed "advisors".

TextBlock.Text: Inside: Military analysts question the viability of carriers against supersonic air attack missiles | Soviet diplomatic corps denies war crimes committed against Japanese civilians in Hokkaido | US President to give emergency address at 2100 EST today
